text:
hana_marketing: Quick PSA  we need to pause the benchmark syndication scheduled for Fri. Legal flagged a privacy policy phrasing change that affects the sample description used in the blog. Need coordinated comms to partners and press.

nate_pr: Copy. What's the exact ask from legal? Do we need to retract anything already sent to embargoed outlets?

anita_legal: Short version: we updated our privacy policy to clarify data sampling provenance. That change means the line in the partner brief claiming 'public-only samples' is potentially misleading. We need to (1) update the partner brief, (2) notify embargoed outlets that the sample description is being revised, and (3) hold syndication until we republish assets. Keep messaging high-level.

liam_growth: Important for metrics: if we delay public syndication, make sure ad tracking windows and social boosts are paused. I'll coordinate with social_ops.

maya_intl: For translations: we'll need the revised brief and any changed captions by 03:00 PT to hit APAC morning. Can you confirm freeze time?

hana_marketing: Proposed immediate actions: A) Nate sends an embargo DM to outlets saying the sample description is under revision and to hold postings; B) Anita will provide the approved wording; C) Maya receives final text by 02:30 PT so translations can finish by 08:30 PT. Sound ok?

pressops_bot: Automated note: flipping release status to "on hold" and notifying all syndication webhooks. Checklist update required: legal sign-off, updated partner brief, new asset pack.

nate_pr: Draft for embargo DM (DRAFT): "We are updating technical language around sample provenance in our upcoming benchmark post. Please hold publication until we send the revised brief. We expect to resend assets within 24 hours. Thank you for holding this under embargo." Thoughts?

anita_legal: Edit: change "technical language" -> "public-facing language clarifying sample provenance" and add: "No operational change to customer data practices; this is a disclosure update." Approved after that tweak.

hana_marketing: I'll update the partner brief with Anita's wording now. Nate, once I post the revision, please DM the embargo list with the approved sentence and an ETA.

liam_growth: Social ops: pausing scheduled paid boosts now. Will resume once we confirm new publish time and assets. Also recommend we shorten the syndication window by 15m to limit early repost risk.

maya_intl: Copy. We'll standby for final copy at 02:30 PT. If it's any later, APAC will miss morning distribution.

carmen_ceo: Keep exec comms simple. If reporters ask, say: "We're updating our public explanation of sample provenance to be clearer; we'll share updated assets shortly." No additional comment.

pressops_bot: Action summary (auto): [anita_legal  approved wording], [hana_marketing  update partner brief], [nate_pr  embargo DMs], [liam_growth  pause/monitor social boosts], [maya_intl  translations on standby]. ETA T-24h.

nate_pr: Sending embargo DMs now with Anita's approved language. Will report confirmations.

hana_marketing: Updated partner brief posted (link: /docs/bench-partner-brief-v2). Key line added per legal. Nate please use this exact sentence in outreach.

nate_pr: 9 outlets acknowledged and agreed to hold. Two asked whether this affects the numbers; I replied per Carmen's guidance.

anita_legal: Thanks. I'll do a final review if any partner asks for additional legal language.

pressops_bot: Status: hold remains in place. Next update in 3h or when translations complete.

hana_marketing: Appreciate fast responses. Once translations are in, we'll reissue a narrow window for syndication and post an internal note to sales/CS about the clarification.
